description: This Java class 'LinkManager' manages serial and TCP connections for communication with an engine control system, including connection handling, threading, and command processing.

classes.name: LinkManager
classes.description: Manages communication links (serial/TCP), threading, and command processing for engine control.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to specified port and waits for connection to be established or fail.

methods.name: LOG_LEVEL
methods.description: Defines the logging level (INFO, DEBUG, TRACE).

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a packed line or packet.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes connection based on port type (serial, TCP, log viewer).

methods.name: isLogViewerMode
methods.description: Checks if the port is the log viewer mode.

methods.name: isLogViewer
methods.description: Checks if current connector is the log viewer.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens connection with a specified listener.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command through the connector.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if the connector has an error.

methods.name: unpackConfirmation
methods.description: Extracts confirmation message from a message.

methods.name: getDefaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default serial port or null if none found.
